result.topic_en: Draft notes on the equations of motion of a rotating fluid ellipsoid: introducing the sums and differences u, v, w, u', v', w' of the rotation quantities p, q, r, p_1, q_1, r_1, writing the resulting system of differential equations for the semi-axes a, b, c, and stating the conservation of areas (vortices) and of vis viva (energy) as first integrals.

methods.what: Pressure on the free surface taken constant, giving the form of the pressure function
Change of variables to half sums and differences of the rotation rates
Second-order equations of motion for the semi-axes
First-order equations for the rotation variables
Conservation of areas (angular momentum) as first integrals
Helmholtz conservation of vorticity gives further integrals
